judul: Tempe vs telur: protein mana lebih tinggi?
judul_en: Tempeh vs egg: which has more protein?

adegan.vo: [curious] Protein siapa | yang lebih tinggi? | {p0}Tempe... | atau {p1}telur?
adegan.vo_en: [curious] Which one | has more protein? | {p0}Tempeh... | or {p1}egg?

adegan.vo: [excited] Jawabannya... | {jawab}TEMPE! | [excited] Per seratus gram, | {label}tempe dua puluh gram protein, | telur cuma dua belas! | [whispers] Tapi awas, ada jebakan angka... | {teaser}di akhir video.
adegan.vo_en: [excited] The answer... | {jawab}TEMPEH! | [excited] Per <100 g=hundred grams>, | {label}tempeh has <20 g=twenty grams> of protein, | egg only <12 g=twelve>! | [whispers] But careful, there's a number trap... | {teaser}at the end of the video.

adegan.vo: [curious] Rahasianya? | {l0}Kedelai, | kacang yang kaya protein. | {l1}Lalu difermentasi | jamur Rhizopus... | [excited] {l2}jadi lebih gampang dicerna!
adegan.vo_en: [curious] The secret? | {l0}Soybeans, | a protein-rich bean. | {l1}Then fermented | by Rhizopus mould... | [excited] {l2}so it's easier to digest!

adegan.vo: [mischievously] Nah, ini jebakannya: | angka tadi per seratus gram. | {b0}Sebutir telur: tujuh koma enam gram. | {b1}Sepotong tempe tipis: | cuma lima koma satu gram! | [laughs] Jadi... | {b2}makan tempenya dua potong!
adegan.vo_en: [mischievously] Now, here's the trap: | those numbers were per hundred grams. | {b0}One egg: <7.6 g=seven point six grams>. | {b1}One thin slice of tempeh: | only <5.1 g=five point one grams>! | [laughs] So... | {b2}eat two slices of tempeh!

adegan.vo: [playful] Tempe: murah, asli Indonesia, | tercatat sejak tahun seribu delapan ratusan! | Kirim ke temanmu | yang suka meremehkan tempe!
adegan.vo_en: [playful] Tempeh: cheap, truly Indonesian, | on record since the <1800s=eighteen hundreds>! | Send this to a friend | who looks down on tempeh!
